name: Kirishima Isami
source: Isami is a class chairman and Tomoya's classmate. She makes sure that students behave well and have done their homework on time. One day it turned out that Kirishima is a neighbor of Tomoya. However, their first meeting as neighbors was somewhat shameful, but this incident made the hero look at chairman as at a woman. Isami is pretty strict, but she easily becomes shy and hesitant when it comes to love affairs.
